subject: AlphaEdge rehearsal: access, test account, and IP warmup
thread_messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@alphaedge.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rehearsal: access, test account, and IP warmup

Hi Tom — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned for your customer-led run this Thursday (May 20):

What we heard from you:
- Peak streaming concurrency target: 180 simultaneous streaming sessions.
- Average generation latency SLO: 95th pct <= 220ms for 256-token responses.
- Sustained throughput target: ~3.5k reqs/min for 5 minute windows during the probe.
- Test tooling: you’ll run k6 (customer scripts) with a short warmup then steady-state ramps.

Our ask / actions:
1) You to send final k6 script bundle (we’ll accept tar.gz).
2) We’ll provision a test API key + a sandbox routing rule with a pinned model variant.
3) Provide IP allowlist CSV for our infra team to open access.
4) Confirm a 90-minute test window: 2027-05-20 09:00–10:30 PT.

Internal notes / owners: Jonas (runtime): validate streaming socket limits and KV cache sizing. Marcus (ops): create test account and apply allowlist.

Attachments: I’ve attached our allowlist template to fill (allowlist-ips-alphaedge.csv). When you send your k6 bundle please reference the file name and we’ll stage it in the shared Drive.

Proposed next step: Tom, can you drop the scripts and the final participant list by EOD tomorrow (May 18)? We’ll confirm IPs and provide the test key within 4 business hours of receiving them.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Note: we’ll also do a quick preflight run (10m) one hour before the official window to validate client routing and health checks.

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@alphaedge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@alphaedge.com>, perfops@alphaedge.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rehearsal: access, test account, and IP warmup

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers below and attaching our k6 bundle.

- We can confirm the 180 concurrency and 3.5k reqs/min targets are accurate.
- Attached: alphaedge-k6-scripts-v1.tar.gz (contains ramping scenario, steady-state, and a short preflight).
- IPs: filled the CSV and attached (allowlist-ips-alphaedge.csv). Primary runner IPs are a small range (198.51.100.20–198.51.100.35).
- Confirming the test window: 2027-05-20 09:00–10:30 PT, preflight at 08:00 PT.

Notes: we’ll run with a single client cert and will rotate headers to simulate 3 different client apps. If you need additional headers or a custom replay token, let us know.

Tom Reynolds
Head of Platform Reliability, AlphaEdge
Tom.Reynolds@alphaedge.com | +1 (206) 555-0112

[Attachment: alphaedge-k6-scripts-v1.tar.gz]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: FW: AlphaEdge assets + allowlist (ACTION: infra prep)

Looping in Ben for allowlist and test API key provisioning. Items:
- Received alphaedge-k6-scripts-v1.tar.gz and allowlist-ips-alphaedge.csv from Tom.
- Test window: 2027-05-20 09:00–10:30 PT; preflight 08:00 PT.
- Targets: 180 streaming concur, 3.5k rpm, 95th pct latency <= 220ms.

Ben — can you do the following before EOD Wednesday (May 19)?
1) Provision sandbox API key scoped to AE-2314 and send secure link to Tom.
2) Apply IP allowlist to the staging ingress (use the attached CSV).
3) Confirm model variant and routing queue sizing with Jonas; suggest keeping the pinned model with 8 GPUs progressive queue during the peak window.
4) Kick a preflight health check at 08:00 PT on Thu and email both Tom and Sofia the results.

If any of this looks risky (capacity or network holes) flag immediately and we’ll propose a slightly smaller ramp.

Thanks —
Marcus
Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: AlphaEdge assets + allowlist (ACTION: infra prep)

All set — quick status update and a couple of questions before we lock the window:

Status:
- Applied IPs from allowlist-ips-alphaedge.csv to staging ingress; rules propagated (IDs: rw-allow-4521, rw-allow-4522).
- Sandbox API key generated: alphaedge-sandbox-20270518 (I’ll share the DocuSign/Secrets link via secure channel once we confirm recipients).
- Staging cluster: pinned 8-GPU pool reserved for the window; Jonas, I left the autoscale headroom at +2 nodes to handle burst.

Questions / clarifications:
- Tom noted multiple client headers to simulate different apps — do we need separate keys per header? Best practice is to use one key and rotate a header; that’s fine but we should rate-limit per-header if they want distinct quotas.
- Are we OK with the warmup preflight at 08:00 PT for 10 minutes? I can run a lightweight steady-state (30% of target) then hand over to them.

If everyone is good I’ll send the secure key link to Tom and Lena and schedule the preflight job.

Ben Carter
Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0106
